questions.question: Consider the following statements about the Agni V ballistic missile and answer which is/are correct? 1- Agni V is an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) of India. 2- Agni V is equipped with MIRV (Multiple Independently Targetable Reentry Vehicle) technology.
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following statements about the Agni V ballistic missile and answer which is/are correct?

1- Agni V is an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) of India.

2- Agni V is equipped with MIRV (Multiple Independently Targetable Reentry Vehicle) technology.
questions.solution:
Statement 1: ✅ Correct

Agni-V is developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and is classified as a long-range ballistic missile, often termed an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) due to its extended range.

Statement 2: ✅ Correct

Agni-V is being upgraded to carry MIRVs (Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicles), which means it can hit multiple targets with a single missile.

questions.question: Consider the following statements and answer which is/are correct? 1- Xylem transports water and minerals from roots to other parts of the plant. 2- Phloem transports food, hormones, and amino acids. 3- Both Xylem and Phloem transports substances only in an upward direction.
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following statements and answer which is/are correct?

1- Xylem transports water and minerals from roots to other parts of the plant.

2- Phloem transports food, hormones, and amino acids.

3- Both Xylem and Phloem transports substances only in an upward direction.
questions.solution:
Statement 1: Correct. Xylem conducts water and minerals from the roots to stems and leaves—this is a unidirectional upward movement.

Statement 2: Correct. Phloem transports food (mainly sucrose), hormones, and amino acids from source (like leaves) to sink (like roots, fruits, etc.).

Statement 3: Incorrect. Xylem transports only upward, but phloem transports in both upward and downward directions, depending on the location of the source and sink.

questions.question: Myopia is also known as:
questions.questionHtml: Myopia is also known as:
questions.solution:
Myopia, or near-sightedness, is a common eye condition where a person can see nearby objects clearly, but distant objects appear blurry.

It occurs when the eyeball is too long or the cornea is too curved, causing light rays to focus in front of the retina instead of directly on it.
